bodies.name: Deutscher Bundestag (German Parliament / Federal Diet)
bodies.layout: The homepage opens with a dense utility bar (language switcher with flags/scripts for Arabic, Bulgarian, Chinese etc., accessibility and search links) above a masthead carrying the Bundestag name and the stylized Bundesadler (federal eagle) crest. Below the sticky main menu (a long horizontal mega-menu covering Bundestag, Abgeordnete, Ausschüsse, Parlamentsfernsehen, Dokumente, Besuche, Presse) sits a large editorial teaser grid mixing plenary-session photography with an orange (#ff7100) call-to-action accent used sparingly against a mostly black-and-white photographic palette. The page is organized into modular horizontal 'bt-module-row' bands: livestream/agenda widgets, a scrolling news teaser carousel, committee-meeting listings, and a multi-column footer with sitemap-style link clusters. Typography is a mix of a humanist sans (Noto Sans Display) for UI chrome and a serif (Noto Serif) for longer editorial headlines, reinforcing a print-derived parliamentary-gazette feel. Overall density is high, favoring information scent and deep-linking over visual whitespace.
ui_patterns: Multi-language top utility bar with script-native language labels (Arabic, Bulgarian, Chinese, etc.)
Mega-menu style primary menu with nested sub-flyouts per committee/topic
Sticky masthead with federal eagle (Bundesadler) crest lockup
Modular 'bt-module-row' content bands (agenda, livestream, news, committee sessions)
Session/plenary calendar widget with date-picker ('Bitte Tag auswählen')
Accreditation and accessibility (Barrierefreiheit) links surfaced in primary chrome
Dense footer sitemap with categorized link columns (Datenschutz, Bibliothek, Datenhandbuch)
Orange (#ff7100) single-accent color used only for interactive/CTA elements against a black/white photo grid

bodies.name: Die Bundesregierung / Presse- und Informationsamt der Bundesregierung (Federal Government / Federal Press Office)
bodies.layout: The site (served from the /breg-de path after redirect) opens with a slim top bar offering language toggles (English, French) and a search icon, above a masthead that pairs the 'Die Bundesregierung' wordmark with federal blue accenting. The 'Hauptnavigation' is a horizontal bar with dropdown mega-menus for Aktuelles, Themen, Bundeskanzler, Bundesregierung, Service, each opening large flyout panels with editorial sub-teasers. The hero area below is a large photographic feature (often of the Chancellor or a cabinet event) paired with a bold BundesSerifWeb headline, followed by a card-based teaser grid summarizing news, videos, and policy explainers rendered with the corporate blue (#0071ad/#004b76) as the dominant chrome color and red/green/gold used sparingly as topic-tag accents. A persistent cookie-consent overlay ('Hinweis zum Datenschutz') appears on first load, and the footer is organized into dense multi-column link clusters (Impressum, Datenschutz, Barrierefreiheit, Sitemap) consistent with federal accessibility (BITV) requirements. The visual system uses the official 'Corporate Design der Bundesregierung' typefaces BundesSansWeb and BundesSerifWeb throughout.
ui_patterns: First-load cookie/consent modal referencing 'Hinweis zum Datenschutz' with granular accept/reject toggles
Mega-menu 'Hauptnavigation' with large flyout panels per top-level topic
Federal-blue (#004b76/#0071ad) dominant corporate color system with topic-color tagging (red/green/gold)
Hero photographic module featuring the Bundeskanzler or cabinet events with serif headline overlay
Language-switcher exposing English/French versions ('Open page in English', 'Lien vers version française')
Card/teaser grid layout for Aktuelles (news) with category-colored tag pills
Rich-text CMS utility classes (cm-richtext) exposing full inline font/color pickers, indicating a heavily templated CMS backend
Dense footer sitemap segmented into legal/service link columns (Impressum, Barrierefreiheit, Datenschutz)

bodies.name: Bundeskriminalamt (Federal Criminal Police Office / BKA)
bodies.layout: Built on the 'Government Site Builder' CMS (a framework shared across several German federal agencies), the BKA homepage opens with a compact utility row (English toggle, sitemap 'Inhalt' link, search) above a masthead carrying the BKA wordmark and federal-blue banding. The 'Hauptmenü' is a sober horizontal menu (Über das BKA, Aufgaben, Kriminalität, Presse, Karriere) with no imagery in the menu itself, reflecting a restrained law-enforcement tone. The hero zone is dominated by an urgent 'Fahndungen' (wanted/most-wanted) module inviting public tips, styled with a red/orange alert accent (#eb5802) against the otherwise blue-and-grey palette. Below that, 'Aktuelle Meldungen' (current press releases) and 'Aktuelle Publikationen' (current publications, e.g. the Bundeslagebild Cybercrime report) are presented as plain text-forward list modules rather than glossy photo cards, and a 'Karriere' (careers) band promotes recruitment. The footer is minimal and legally-oriented (Impressum, Datenschutz, Barrierefreiheitserklärung), and the overall visual density is low-ornamentation, high-authority, favoring accessible/BITV-conformant markup over decorative styling.
ui_patterns: Public 'Fahndungen' (wanted-persons) module with call-to-action styled in an urgent orange/red accent
Government Site Builder CMS footprint (shared modular CSS files: normalize/small/medium/large/xlarge breakpoints)
Sober text-first 'Aktuelle Meldungen' press-release list with minimal imagery
'Blätterfunktion' (browse/paging) control for cycling through news items
Strict BITV/accessibility-statement conformance footer link
Careers ('Arbeiten beim BKA') promoted as a persistent homepage band
Two-tone federal-blue (#0055a5 / #133c75) chrome with grey neutral surfaces, no decorative gradients
Aural-only headings (class="aural") for screen-reader section landmarks, indicating strict accessibility compliance
